public_entry.trigger: Search / services hub / Road Ready recommendation / Start Your Business journey item “IFTA / Fuel Tax”

discovery: Start Your Business journey item “IFTA / Fuel Tax”
must_understand: IFTA is the quarterly fuel tax report for qualifying interstate carriers
it is due every quarter (Apr 30 · Jul 31 · Oct 31 · Jan 31)
it needs fuel receipts and miles by state
AIO builds, checks and files it with you — you approve before anything is filed
perspective.who_its_for: Interstate carriers with qualified motor vehicles and an active IFTA account (AIO can help set the account up first).
what_we_handle: turning ELD / trip records into miles by state
keeping the quarter in your Vault
reminding you before the next one
what_client_provides: fuel receipts (photo, upload or from your Vault)
miles by state (ELD report, import, spreadsheet or manual)
how_it_works: Send receipts and miles as you go
The filed quarter lands in your Vault
perspective.outcome: A filed quarterly IFTA return with confirmation and the full record in your Vault — and the next quarter already open.
perspective.timing: Quarterly; due the last day of the month after each quarter.
perspective.pricing_relationship: Quote required (per-quarter service fee by fleet size); fuel tax owed is the carrier’s own liability, separate from AIO fees.
perspective.workspace_continuity: The page shows the same six-step quarter the client will live in the workspace (open → send → review → approve → filed → vault) and the same quarter card visual — no surprise UI after signup.

features.continuity: The page shows the same six-step quarter the client will live in the workspace (open → send → review → approve → filed → vault) and the same quarter card visual — no surprise UI after signup.
